entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet new --no-update-check` does not suppress Optional workloads provider notice #55386
  • Deprecated package referenced on main #55373

Closed

  • `dotnetup env`, `everywhere` mode should also modify the profile file #55385
  • dotnet watch fails to read staticwebassets.development.json on macOS when IntermediateOutputPath contains mixed separators #54309
  • [Source Build] NativeAOT dotnet CLI library is packaged with embedded symbols #55381
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55262
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55186
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55308
  • Why are some packages not appearing on nuget.org? #55374
  • NativeAOT CLI: file-based app detection throws FileNotFoundException for 'Microsoft.Build' under AOT #54806
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers v10.0.301: CA30xx interprocedural analysis causes infinite build / StackOverflow on .NET Framework 4.8 projects #55214
  • Use 'dotnet test' to run .NET unit tests on Android #26930
  • Microsoft.Testing.Platform test host crash on shutdown: "Failed to flush logs before the timeout of '300' seconds" (FileLogger.Dispose) #55215
  • Enable NAOT dotnet CLI package for Source Build #55283
    11.0.1xx
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-testprogressstateawareterminal: drift detected (#0) #55371
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-simpleterminalbase: drift detected (#0) #55370
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-iterminal: drift detected (#0) #55369
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-ansiterminaltestprogressframe: drift detected (#0) #55368
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-ansiterminal: drift detected (#0) #55367
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#6) #55366
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#0) #55365
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-wire-contract-constants: drift detected (#0) #55364
  • Allow `dotnet test --list-tests json` #49754

PullRequests

Created

  • Add prototype `dotnetup` support policy doc #55390
  • Run wasm test hosts standalone under `dotnet test` (MTP) #55389
  • Add test authoring guidance for Helix compatibility and TFM properties #55388
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55387
  • Reference Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Authoring.Tasks in template package template #55384
  • Fix CS0579 flake: exclude nested project dirs from parent project default item globs #55382
  • Backport MTP handshake failure diagnostics #55377
    Servicing-consider
  • Support --nologo in Microsoft.Testing.Platform test mode #55376

Merged

  • fix: normalize IntermediateOutputPath slashes in posix platforms #54536
    Area-Watch
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55328
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.4xx' #55375
  • Enable NativeAOT dotnet CLI for Source Build #55329
    Area-SourceBuild, Area-dotnet AOT
  • Reconcile testfx vendored source baselines #55372
  • Batch WithSource project-file rewrites into a single pass #55269
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #55323
  • Apply dotnet test zero-tests verdict at the whole-run level #55362
  • Update CODEOWNERS for dotnet-testing team #55363
  • Add `dotnet test --list-tests json` via SDK-side rendering #55299
  • Align MSTest/testfx package versions and document the sync requirement #55316

Updated

  • Conditional test filtering framework for PR builds #55166
  • Add platform-native local container CLI support #55249
    breaking-change, Area-Containers
  • dotnetup: Improve "everywhere" access mode #55360
  • Resolve analyzers from the analyzers group in project.assets.json #54646
  • Scope .editorconfig discovery to included files in dotnet format folder mode #55248
  • Reorganize compatibility test projects under test/Compatibility #55240
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55289
  • dotnetup: classify PATH dotnet by managed hive; fix env config doc #55349
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #55267
  • [Draft] Support Microsoft.Build.Traversal projects in dotnet test (MTP) #55297
  • Migrate DefineStaticWebAssets to multithreaded task execution #55117
